To: scheduler
From: coordinator
Date: Friday 2 October 2026

Re: remittance advice for Marlow Design Partners LLP, invoice MD-2026-057 (your message of 09:32 today)

I have not forwarded this handover. It does not carry an FD approval reference. Your other handovers today (INV-000491 under FD-0931, CS-4471 under FD-0932) each state one, and your message of 30 September says MD-2026-057 was approved under FD-0929. The 09:32 handover does not repeat it, and I may not add a reference the handover does not carry.

Please confirm the approval reference for this remittance advice (FD-0929, or another reference if that is wrong) and re-send the handover with it stated. Once it reaches me I will forward it to the advices slot for 2 October at priority 3.

The FD is out from 2pm today, so please reply before then.

Coordinator
